newsitem.title: FINLAND: HUHTAMAKI TO BUY ASIA-PACIFIC CUPS FIRM.
newsitem.headline: HUHTAMAKI TO BUY ASIA-PACIFIC CUPS FIRM.

text.p: Finnish confectionery and packaging group Huhtamaki Oy said in a statement on Tuesday it would buy a privately-owned maker of cups and containers in the Asia-Pacific region.

"Huhtamaki ... has agreed to acquire the Pacific World Packaging Group (PWP), one of the leading manufacturers of cups and containers for the food and food service industries in the Asia-Pacific region," it said.
PWP's annual net sales were around 350 million markka, Huhtamaki said. It did not give the price of the deal or any other financial details.

"PWP is a financially sound company and will complement Huhtamaki's Polarcup division both geographically and in terms of technologies and business segments," Huhtamaki CEO Timo Peltola said in the statement.
PWP is strong in Hong Kong, China and Taiwan while Polarcup's presence is concentrated in Southeast Asia. Both companies are present in Australia but focus on different products, Huhtamaki said.
It also said that the PWP deal meant Polarcup would not carry on with a planned $35 million investment in a production plant in Wuxi, China.
